hypothesis: A nearest-centroid classifier using sepal width alone improves test accuracy by at least 0.10 over the same classifier using petal length alone.
unit: one dataset row; independence across rows is not established

source.citation: Fisher, R. (1936). Iris [Dataset]. UCI Machine Learning Repository.

split.method: For each species, order by SHA-256 of seed:zero-based CSV row index. First ten are test. Fit all centroids on the remaining rows only.

negative_control.method: Shuffle training labels for the sepal-width classifier only.

criterion.method: Paired one-sided exact binomial test on discordant test predictions. The p-value is descriptive conditional on this split.

review: Lyra; internal engineering and scientific review required before DONE
